name: RTX 5090: Qwen3 32B Q4_K_M decode tokens/sec
methodology: llama.cpp CUDA backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, Q4_K_M quantization, 32GB VRAM
notes: RTX 5090 with 32GB GDDR7 at 1792 GB/s. A 32B model at Q4_K_M requires ~18GB of VRAM, fitting comfortably. The 1792 GB/s bandwidth yields high decode throughput. This is the sweet spot for the RTX 5090: large enough for 32B models with room for KV cache, fast enough for interactive use.
